CARD_NOT_PRESENT_RING.name: Card-Not-Present (CNP) Fraud Ring
CARD_NOT_PRESENT_RING.description: Organized rings testing stolen card credentials via low-value probing transactions before high-value purchases. Characterised by multiple accounts sharing device fingerprints, rapid cross-merchant testing, and geographic impossibilities.
CARD_NOT_PRESENT_RING.graph_pattern: Account -> Device <- Account (shared device with >3 accounts within 7 days)

ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER.name: Account Takeover (ATO)
ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER.description: Fraudster gains unauthorized access to a legitimate customer account via credential stuffing, phishing, or SIM swap. Signature: sudden device/IP change, password reset, address update followed by large transaction.
ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER.graph_pattern: Account -> NewDevice (device never seen before) AND IP_Address (foreign country)

BUST_OUT.name: Bust-Out Fraud
BUST_OUT.description: Fraudster builds credit history on synthetic or real identity, maxes out credit lines, then disappears. Characterised by sudden maximum utilization, no prior high-value transactions, address changes, and shared identities across multiple busted accounts.
BUST_OUT.graph_pattern: Account (young) -> high_value_transactions BURST within 48h AND Account -> Email_Domain <- Account (shared domain)

SYNTHETIC_IDENTITY.name: Synthetic Identity Fraud
SYNTHETIC_IDENTITY.description: Fraudster creates a fictitious identity by combining real PII fragments (valid SSN + fake name/DOB). Multiple synthetic identities often share device hardware or IP, connected through a hidden orchestrator.
SYNTHETIC_IDENTITY.graph_pattern: WCC component: >5 Accounts sharing Device AND IP_Address with no social connections

SMURFING_VELOCITY.name: Smurfing / Structuring / Velocity Fraud
SMURFING_VELOCITY.description: Fraudster breaks large illicit transfers into smaller amounts below reporting thresholds ($10,000 CTR limit) across multiple accounts or time periods to evade detection. High fan-out from a single originator.
SMURFING_VELOCITY.graph_pattern: Account -> [10+ Transactions in 24h, each $9,000-$9,999] -> multiple Accounts

ADD_TO_WATCHLIST.description: Flag account for enhanced monitoring without blocking

BLOCK_TRANSACTION.description: Decline the specific transaction; account remains active

STEP_UP_AUTH.description: Trigger MFA challenge before allowing transaction

FREEZE_ACCOUNT.description: Temporarily freeze all account activity pending investigation

ACCOUNT_HOLD.description: Place legal hold on account funds

FILE_SAR.description: File Suspicious Activity Report with FinCEN within 30 days

ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.description: Route to human analyst for manual review
